ABS Outstanding : Vessel owner reported failure of Diesel Generator Engine No 3. Vessel was boarded by undersigned on 01 October 2026 and it was reported by vessel crew that initially exhaust valve of Unit Number 5 failed which caused damage to Piston and Rocker arm of aforementioned unit. It was also reported that all cylinder heads on this engine were overhauled. But during testing it was noted that engine will not start. Vessel crew trouble shot the problem to be the Turbocharger of this engine. It was noted that the rotor of the turbocharger is not spinning and crew suspects that broken pieces of valves might have made its way to turbocharger causing damage to it. Vessel crew reported that new turbocharger is on order and has long lead time. During survey attendance all three remaining Generator engines(1,2 and 4) were tried on load satisfactorily. Per Electrical Load Analysis, one generator is sufficient to carry sea going load.
